newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Plutonic lifts debt facility to A$400 mln.
newsitem.headline: Plutonic lifts debt facility to A$400 mln.

text.p: Gold miner Plutonic Resources Ltd said on Tuesday it had increased a syndicated debt facility to A$400 million from A$350 million due to oversubscriptions from key banks.
Plutonic on May 27 said it had named ABN AMRO Australia Ltd, The Chase Manhattan Bank and Credit Suisse Boston to underwrite the facility.

At that time, Plutonic said the facility would be used to refinance existing bank debt, capital expansion plans, acquisitions consistent with the company's business and for general working capital requirements.
